message.content:
The Eiffel Tower is repainted roughly every seven years, and the whole process normally takes about **three months**.

Here’s how that figure comes about:

| Step | Approximate time |
|------|------------------|
| **Preparation (cleaning, priming)** | 1–2 weeks |
| **Painting (multiple coats, including primer, base coat, topcoat)** | 8–10 weeks |
| **Dry‑time & inspection** | 1–2 weeks |

So from start to finish you’re looking at around **90 days**, give or take a week or two depending on weather, crew size, and whether any special finishes are applied.
